metadata.purpose: causal moving-average and volume strategy study
metadata.execution: signal at close; execute at next trading-day open
selection_protocol: select parameters within each family using 2015-2020 training only
select the final family using 2021-2023 validation only
inspect 2024-2026-08-20 test only after both selections are fixed
annual walk-forward selects parameters from the previous five years
constraints: skip entry when next open is at estimated up-limit
delay exit when next open is at estimated down-limit
metadata.drawdown_note: Period equity resets at one and uses only trades entered in that period. Drawdown is measured on closed-trade equity and understates intratrade drawdown.
limitations: Passing a historical gate cannot guarantee future success.
Point-in-time index cohorts reduce but do not eliminate selection and survivorship bias.
Daily OHLCV cannot prove intraday path or queue position.
Sell event accuracy is directional and does not include an investor-specific cost basis.
Market regime labels use full-year returns and are diagnostic, never trading inputs.

final_selection.selection_basis: family parameters selected on training; final family selected on validation

release_gates.definition: Historical research release gate only. Passing would not guarantee future profitability or a user's realized success rate.
